capture.method: read the complete leaf type module from each pinned Git blob and compile each pinned tree with tsc --noEmit

stableDifference: the stable source has the same row union and fields except that it predates RenderSpan.transformFg; the pinned main baseline adds the deferred foreground transform and is the target contract

collapsedGapPosition.identity: the shared review gap position type

contract.transformIdentity: adjacent-span merging compares deferred foreground transforms by function identity

rustProjection.optionalTrue: is_expansion_row bool; false represents the absent TypeScript property and true represents its only permitted present value
rustProjection.sharedGapType: workdeck_core::ReviewGapPosition, re-exported unchanged by workdeck-review and aliased by workdeck-diff

rustParityTests: the existing workdeck-review expansion test suite verifies the relocated shared gap type without behavior changes
normalization: Rust snake_case field spelling and Option/bool representation only; union variants, admissible cell kinds, ranges, move markers, shared gap identity, span paint data, and deferred transform identity are preserved
